title: Emodin relieves morphine-stimulated BV2 microglial activation and inflammation through the TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway.
authors: Li, Shimei; Tang, Songjiang; Dai, Lina; Jian, Zhonglu; Li, Xi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大黄素通过TLR4/NF-kB/NLRP3通路缓解吗啡诱导的小胶质细胞活化与炎症，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The objective of this study is to disclose the role of emodin, a natural anthraquinone derivative that has been proposed to suppress microglial activation and inflammation, in morphine tolerance. Here, cell counting kit-8 method assayed the viability of BV2 microglial cells treated by ascending concentrations of emodin. In emodin-pretreated BV2 microglial cells challenged with morphine with or without transfection of toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) overexpression plasmids, transwell assay measured cell migration. Immunofluorescence staining and western blot detected the expression of microglial markers. Inflammatory levels were subjected to ELISA and western blot. BODIPY 581/591 C11 assay estimated lipid reactive oxygen species activity. Iron assay kit examined total iron content. Western blot tested the expression of ferroptosis- and TLR4/nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB)/NOD-like receptor 3 (NLRP3) pathway-associated proteins. Molecular docking predicted the binding affinity of emodin to TLR4. Emodin was noted to obstruct the migration, activation, inflammatory response, and ferroptosis of BV2 microglial cells induced by morphine. In addition, emodin had a high binding affinity with TLR4 and inactivated TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway in morphine-challenged BV2 microglial cells. Upregulation of TLR4 partially countervailed the protective role of emodin against morphine-elicited BV2 microglial cell migration, activation, inflammation, and ferroptosis. Accordingly, emodin might target TLR4 and act as an inactivator of TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway, thus inhibiting BV2 microglial activation and inflammation to mitigate morphine tolerance.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在揭示大黄素（emodin，一种天然蒽醌衍生物，已被提出可抑制小胶质细胞活化和炎症）在吗啡耐受中的作用。此处，细胞计数试剂盒-8法检测了经递增浓度大黄素处理的BV2小胶质细胞的活力。在经大黄素预处理并接受吗啡刺激（伴或不伴toll样受体4（TLR4）过表达质粒转染）的BV2小胶质细胞中，transwell实验测量了细胞迁移。免疫荧光染色和western blot检测了小胶质细胞标志物的表达。炎症水平通过ELISA和western blot测定。BODIPY 581/591 C11实验评估了脂质活性氧活性。铁检测试剂盒检测了总铁含量。Western blot检测了铁死亡及TLR4/核因子-kappaB（NF-kappaB）/NOD样受体3（NLRP3）通路相关蛋白的表达。分子对接预测了大黄素与TLR4的结合亲和力。研究发现，大黄素可阻碍吗啡诱导的BV2小胶质细胞迁移、活化、炎症反应和铁死亡。此外，大黄素与TLR4具有高结合亲和力，并在吗啡刺激的BV2小胶质细胞中使TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路失活。TLR4的上调部分抵消了大黄素对吗啡诱导的BV2小胶质细胞迁移、活化、炎症和铁死亡的保护作用。因此，大黄素可能靶向TLR4并作为TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路的失活剂，从而抑制BV2小胶质细胞活化和炎症，以减轻吗啡耐受。
